verdict.rationale: Auth0's own Actions are versioned, tenant-hosted Node.js functions that run automatically inside login and identity flows, and log streaming exports tenant logs to an analysis service in near real time without manual work. These are event-triggered, server-side automations, but they are tied to identity events rather than general-purpose background automations a user configures. The CLI's "automate tasks" and the agent tooling (CIBA, Token Vault, MCP server) are building blocks for developer-built agents and are not credited here. Missing for 10: scheduled or general-purpose background jobs or workflows, any documentation of autonomous automation setup beyond login-flow hooks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
